rows.alt: or buy Aya from players at 5-8 p each

conditions: Check the live Varzia rotation first: if Mesa is currently unvaulted her relics drop from missions normally and this farm is unnecessary
bonuses: Volt or Nova, not optional: Speed buffs the escort drone, Nova's portal teleports it. Keep the portal exit near ground level and stay close or the drone refuses it
Overfarmed Aya trades at 5-8 p, commonly 6 for 36 p, so a long session is a platinum farm too

conditions: Varzia carries Mesa relics only while a Mesa rotation is live; stock rotates every 28 days at 18:00 UTC
No mission drops these relics. Farming fissures hoping for Mesa relics is wasted time
bonuses: Varzia is also on the Orbiter Market console, which saves the trip to Mars every rotation

disclosures.title: the relics not picked
disclosures.body: Blueprint also sits at Uncommon 11% in Lith C6, Lith D1, Lith N9, Lith P7, Meso P3, Meso R2, Neo Z2 and Neo Z3; Vanguard P1 is the only Common one. Chassis is Common in all ten of its relics, so Axi H4, Lith R1, Lith S10, Meso C4, Meso L2, Neo A3, Neo C1, Neo R4 and Vanguard E1 are interchangeable with Axi M1. Neuroptics is Rare 2% in every relic that holds it: Lith M4, Lith M5, Axi M3, Axi M4 and Vanguard M1 are the same odds as Lith M3. Systems is Uncommon 11% in Neo H3 and Vanguard C1 as well, and Rare 2% in Lith M6, Neo M2 and Neo M3, which are the ones to avoid.

groups.activity: match the relic era; Vanguard runs at Axi tier
conditions: Equip the relic before launch and collect 10 Reactant. Falling short does not consume the relic
Neuroptics is the Rare slot in every relic that holds it, so it is the part that stalls the set
bonuses: Radiant the Neuroptics relic: 100 traces turns 2% into 10%. Do the same for a rare-slot Systems relic if you are running one
Run Vanguard P1 and the Chassis relics Intact. Refining lowers Common odds, which is the wrong direction for both
A full squad gives four reward rolls to choose from
Spare Commons sell for 15 ducats each, and Intact is the refinement level that maximises them

disclosures.title: refinement table
disclosures.body: Intact 0 traces: 25.33% each Common, 11% Uncommon, 2% Rare. Exceptional 25 traces: 23.33 / 13 / 4. Flawless 50 traces: 20 / 17 / 6. Radiant 100 traces: 16.67 / 20 / 10. A crack pays 6-30 traces when you collect 10 Reactant, plus 5 for every squadmate who picks your reward.

bonuses: 25 p rushes any one of them, but all three run in parallel anyway

conditions: 84h of build timers end to end, so the last part dropping is not the last thing standing between you and the frame
Needs a free Warframe slot before the Foundry will let you claim it
